scripts.nwwdwd: concurrently --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev" "npm run server"
scripts.p:mongo-stop: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$svc = Get-Service -Name MongoDB -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq 'Running') { Write-Host '[p:mongo-stop] Stopping local MongoDB service so the SSH tunnel can bind 27017...'; try { Stop-Service -Name MongoDB -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Write-Host '[p:mongo-stop] Stopped.' } catch { Write-Warning ('[p:mongo-stop] Could not stop MongoDB service (run PowerShell as admin or set the service to Manual). ' + $_.Exception.Message) } } else { Write-Host '[p:mongo-stop] Local MongoDB service not running. OK.' }"
